scan.exactStringTables: All seven DEX string tables were checked for every one of the 162 inventory names.
scan.fieldTables: All seven DEX field tables were checked for resolved SettingCharacteristics key fields.
scan.methodBodies: Only classes4.dex and classes5.dex contained the six exact literals or resolved fields; every defined method in those two DEX files was scanned for literal and field references.
scan.methodClassification: Method-level roles are based on co-occurring Camera2 API invokes and field access; they do not prove runtime execution.

limitations: Inventory directions come from device-observed Camera2 metadata and are not inferred from stock APK usage.
CaptureRequest.Key declarations confirm the Java key class and value type for four exact literals only.
No exact static reference does not prove runtime non-use; reflection, dynamic strings, JNI/native code, firmware-side code and missing split APKs remain outside this analysis.
Method-level field access classification is static and does not prove the branch executed on Galaga.
